title: Location
description: Information about a specific geographic location

bbox.title: bounding box
bbox.description: bounding box of a location (in any coordinate system)

anyOf.description: Bounding box represented in some string format

centroid.title: centroid
centroid.description: The geographic center (centroid) of a location

anyOf.description: Center point in some string format

identifier.title: identifier
identifier.description: A list of geographic identifiers for the location, e.g., the URI or other unique identifier in the context of the relevant gazetteer

geometry.title: geometry
geometry.description: Associates a location with a corresponding geometry

anyOf.description: String format of the full geometry of the location

inScheme.title: gazetteer
inScheme.description: The gazetteer to which the location belongs

altLabel.title: alternative name
altLabel.description: An alternative name for a location

altLabelMap.description: Language map for the alternative name. E.g. {'es': 'spanish words', 'fr': 'french words'}

prefLabelMap.description: Language map for geographic name. E.g. {'es': 'spanish words', 'fr': 'french words'}
